audit_amendment.reason: Pre-run hostile audit corrected route naming, made the theorem passport explicit, and added replay/source-hash requirements.

claim_under_test.name: HT-HAT(0.019)
claim_under_test.finite_statement: For each frozen Y, P_Y(t) >= -Y^(-19/1000) throughout [Y^(931/2000), Y^(50/33)].
claim_under_test.asymptotic_statement: The same inequality holds for every sufficiently large admissible Y.
claim_under_test.scope_warning: A finite pass is only a fixed-vector, fixed-scale statement. It is not the asymptotic theorem, the prior two-sided raw high-tail approximation theorem, DPA_P(0.019), a uniform zero-free strip, or RH.

theorem_passport.role: Bounded falsifier for one explicit positive directional-polynomial candidate
theorem_passport.source_and_mask: Ordinary primes only, in the complete multiplicative shell [Y*exp(-1/5),Y*exp(1/5)]
theorem_passport.coefficient_cone: One fixed nonnegative nodal-hat vector; no optimization after the band is known
theorem_passport.normalization: Probability normalization by the computed truncated raw mass on [v_1,v_J]

quantifiers.finite_run: Four explicitly listed half-integer Y values
quantifiers.desired_asymptotic: Every sufficiently large admissible Y and every t in the full high band

theorem_passport.floor_and_resolution: One-sided floor -Y^(-19/1000), certified on the continuum by Arb endpoint interpolation
theorem_passport.relation_to_prior_high_tail_edge: This one-sided normalized floor is weaker than the prior report's two-sided raw |b-P| approximation target. It is a legitimate explicit DPA candidate diagnostic, not a proof or exact execution of that stronger theorem.
theorem_passport.downstream_adapter: Together with the existing low/mid O(Y^(-.019)) estimate, an asymptotic HT-HAT(.019) would directly give DPA_P(c) for every c<.019, not coefficient-one DPA_P(.019) without a constant sharpening. One may choose .0189<c<.019 for the contemplated QP contradiction.
theorem_passport.parallel_open_sibling: LTRAD_P(.0189,.001) remains independently open; HT-HAT alone does not yield the QP contradiction or a zero-free strip.
theorem_passport.route_ceiling: Even closing both QP siblings would establish only the contemplated small zero-free strip near Re(s)=1, not RH without a new amplifier.

construction.prime_mask: ordinary primes p with Y*exp(-w) <= p <= Y*exp(w)
construction.raw_weight: integral of phi times the piecewise-linear nodal hat on [v_1,v_J]
construction.normalization: divide every raw weight by their computed sum, not by the full theoretical tent mass

half_grid.description: Fix endpoint nodes and snap every interior node to the nearest same-sign odd multiple of pi/B, where B=Y^(50/33); abort if order or uniqueness fails.
half_grid.required_sanity: At t=B every snapped interior cosine is -1 up to floating error.

order_preserving_jitter.formula: v_j' = v_j + eta*r_j*xi_j, r_j=(1/4)min(v_j-v_(j-1),v_(j+1)-v_j,|v_j|), xi_j uniform on [-1,1] from NumPy PCG64; endpoints fixed.

controls.limitation: Controls preserve coarse geometry only; they do not preserve primality, integrality, or higher arithmetic correlations.

certification.arithmetic: python-flint Arb with directed ball arithmetic
certification.precision_policy: Repeat decisive actual-vector certifications with the same implementation at 256 bits and require the same strict result; this is a stability check, not independent software verification.
certification.replay_policy: Serialize every accepted dyadic leaf, verify prefix-free complete coverage and Kraft sum 1, hash the source, then execute a from-disk recomputation of the 256-bit leaf hash.
certification.pass_rule: PASS only when every leaf of a complete continuum cover has rigorous lower bound at least -Y^(-19/1000).
certification.fail_rule: FAIL only when an Arb ball at a point proved inside the exact band has upper endpoint below -Y^(-19/1000).

stopping_rule: Run exactly the four frozen centers. Do not add scales, alter parameters, or promote trends after inspecting outcomes.
primary_outputs: actual fixed-vector floating scout and Arb continuum status
half-grid and jitter control minima, including their values at the actual argmin
prime, node, gap, mass, and weight fingerprints
replayable dyadic leaf certificates and SHA-256 hashes
